## 401aff907774

**No issue found in the checked domain.** I checked generator SHA-256
`86fbdeeb3e33419207c043216a25a550c57eea02a300de75ef66687521ef30b5`
with declared rule hash `abc6ea951972`. Its Python crop oracle matched all three
canonical pairs. The two shortcuts that fit every canonical pair—cropping the
all-nonzero bounding box inset by one, and tightly cropping only interior nonzeros—
were both rejected by every tested complete lesson.

The retained probe covers 900 same-seed lessons: easy/medium/hard, seeds 0–24,
starts 0–11, three consecutive demonstrations plus the next query. Every window
contained all three scheduled profiles; none of the five declared competitors fit
all demonstrations, `lesson_identifiable` returned no reason, and no query-changing
competitor survived. Evidence: `checks/audit/401aff907774/probe.json`. This is a
finite declared-rival and schedule-window check, not a proof against every possible
inductive shortcut.
